title: The King Who Forgot to Stay Humble
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler who is brave, and tonight a strong king forgets to be humble: Beau learns to ride his bike, forgets who held the seat, and finds the brave words sorry and thank you.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because the bravest thing a strong person can do is stay humble, and tonight a strong young king forgets how. In Beau’s world today: Beau finally rides his bike without training wheels. Dad ran beside him all week, holding the seat. Now Beau zooms up and down the sidewalk shouting, “I did it all by myself! I don’t need anybody!” When Dad says, “Remember, we stop at the corner,” Beau frowns and rides right past it. A car honks, and Beau tips over into the grass. Dad runs to him and helps him up. Beau takes a big breath and says, “Sorry, Dad. And thank you for holding the seat.” Just like King Uzziah’s story, Beau learned that a big heart remembers who helped, and that every good gift comes from God.
